In the static spherical sector the deep matching g*mu_n(g/s)=g_N implies g^2=(s/n)*g_N, i.e. a0=s/n and kappa=a0/s=1/n; at the adopted n=2, kappa=1/2. This is invariant under the same-theory redefinition Phi'=lambda*Phi with matter coupling rho*Phi=rho*Phi'/lambda: g'^2=lambda^2*(s/n)*g_N and g=g'/lambda imply exactly g^2=(s/n)*g_N for every lambda>0 (residual 0, verified numerically to 4.4e-16 on the root grid). Slope measured against the primed gradient in fixed-s units Z'=lambda*Y is n/lambda, so the slope claim survives redefinitions ONLY in the physical variable Y=g/s. Negative control: with the coupling UNCHANGED (rho'=rho), a0_c=lambda*s/n, kappa_c=lambda/n (n=2, lambda in {1/2,1,2}: kappa_c={1/4,1/2,1}); deep root ratio sqrt(lambda), Newtonian ratio 1.
